To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the GAN training procedure is inherently fragile, (ii) this is caused by the fact that the support of the model distribution and of the data distribution do not overlap, and (iii) we propose a simple regularization technique that allows for stable and reliable training of GANs.
we propose a regularization method for GANs, which we call the Gradient Penalty Regularizer (GPR) that is easy to implement and yields a stable training procedure.
we propose a new regularization technique for GANs that allows them to be trained in a stable manner and we demonstrate its effectiveness on several image generation tasks.
